model_exclusion.explanation: This poll is listed for the record but is not used in the forecast. Scope Research described its method only briefly: an online survey of people invited by text message, with no account of how respondents were chosen or weighted. Scope has not published earlier polls that can be checked against an election result, so there is no record yet of how accurate its polls are. Scope is also not a member of the Canadian Research Insights Council, the industry body that sets standards for Canadian polling firms.
